card.name: Digits inside section and version numbers
card.fires_on: A single digit right after a decimal point in a section, regulation, or version number, such as 8.4.6, 4.03 or §35.200. It does not fire on ordinary quantities.

modes.label: Section numbers
modes.description: A digit after a dot in a chapter, code, or standards citation.

modes.label: Version numbers
modes.description: The last digit of a version such as CTCAE 4.03.
